emphasis_points: Highlight weather-conscious materials (e.g., rust-resistant powder-coated iron, synthetic rattan/wicker, treated teak, outdoor mesh) and open-air resilience.
Describe space-conscious silhouettes optimized for compact balconies, verandas, sunrooms, and garden terraces.
Detail seating suspension, chain/hook stability (for swings), and drainage or breathable weave that supports open-air leisure.
avoid_list: Do not claim 100% waterproof or impervious exterior durability unless backed by formal weatherproofing specifications.
Do not assume ceiling hooks, carabiners, or structural mounting hardware are included unless listed.
Do not ignore basic outdoor care realities: recommend protective coverings or sheltering during monsoon/monsoon storage.
tone_notes: Breezy, durable, and refreshing, connecting domestic tranquility with outdoor elements and leisure.
